2026 World Cup no San Francisco Bay Area matches no, wɔbɛto wɔ Santa Clara, kurow a ɛwɔ Silicon Valley anaafoɔ nkyɛn bɛyɛ 40 miles south of downtown San Francisco. Santa Clara fii aseɛ wɔ 1777, ɛberɛ a wɔde Mission Santa Clara de Asís too hɔ; wɔde no yɛɛ kurow wɔ 1852. San Francisco metro a ɛwɔ hɔ no kɔ akyiri bio, kɔ Spanish presidio ne mission wɔ 1776, ansa na Gold Rush wɔ 1849 reboom.

Nne Santa Clara yɛ tech-industry hub, na Levi's Stadium de Bay Area no kɔ 2026 host region. FIFA "San Francisco Bay Area" host designation no yɛ broad pɛ, na ɛtrɛ Santa Clara ne San Jose ne Bay metropolitan area nyinaa, ɛnyɛ municipality baako pɛ.

Ɛfiri sɛ venue no wɔ kurow ketewa mu, region no football identity no, yɛnhunu no yiye sɛ yɛfa metro no nyinaa. San Francisco Bay Area yɛ United States soccer-engaged mpɛn mu biako. San Jose Earthquakes, a wɔadi MLS Cup mprenu, bɛn wɔ PayPal Park, na mpɛn no kura fan base a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ na ɛsono — a Mexican-American support a ɛyɛ den ma El Tri friendlies ne Copa América ne Gold Cup matches ka ho. Anigyeɛ yi ne track record a wɔde major international tournaments to, a Copa América Centenario wɔ 2016 ne CONCACAF Gold Cup wɔ 2017 ka ho.

Bay Area no anigyeɛ ma agoru no wɔ general sports culture a ɛyɛ deep unusual mu. Region no nyinaa, allegiances trɛ 49ers, Giants, Warriors ne A's mu, na ɛde Santa Clara World Cup venue no ma metropolitan audience a wɔahwɛ top-tier competition dedaw. Ɛyɛ combination no — Silicon Valley setting, broad multi-city host footprint, ne ɔman no mu soccer followings a ɛyɛ committed paa — na ɛde San Francisco Bay Area kɔ 2026 host.
